title: Serving and eating

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Use gestures to communicate enjoyment and service so food imagery has a human narrative.
strategic_value: A pizza carrier, diner and serving hand can bring warmth and variety to Helsinki’s food communications.
demonstration: A small food truck sits upper left; a seated diner, pizza-carrying figure, raised cup and tray-bearing hand spread across pale blue.
practical_value: Select a gesture that expresses the intended action rather than relying only on a food object.

content_islands.spec: Pair the small truck and seated eater across the upper left and middle.

content_islands.name: Serving gestures
content_islands.spec: Place the pizza carrier, raised cup and tray-bearing hand around them.
